title: Check Vendor Contracts Before They Auto-Renew
summary: Track renewal dates for vendor contracts, and review the terms of each renewal or replacement before the notice window closes.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you hold vendor contracts with auto-renewal; the value is fewer missed notice windows and terms checked before you commit.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labeled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Renewal dates are on one list, so no contract renews by accident.
Terms are checked before the notice window closes, not after.
who_its_for: Owner-run businesses with several software and service contracts.
Operations leads who manage vendor renewals.

stack.name: Contract Renewal Reminder
stack.role: Tracks vendor renewal dates and sends reminders before they auto-renew.
stack.creator: Trung Tran

stack.name: Contract Signer
stack.role: Flags risky or missing terms in a renewal or replacement contract, in plain language.
stack.creator: Julian Andrin Weber

inputs.label: Contract renewal dates and notice periods

steps.name: Contract Renewal Reminder
steps.does: Sends reminders before each notice window

steps.name: You
steps.does: Decides to renew, renegotiate or cancel

outputs: A plain-language list of terms to check

steps: List each vendor contract with its renewal date and notice period.
Let the reminder bot send alerts before each notice window.
Ask the contract signer to flag the terms of any renewal or replacement.
Decide to renew, renegotiate or cancel, and sign only what you approve.
guardrails: No contract is signed or cancelled without your approval.
Check notice periods against the contract itself; the reminder is only as good as the dates entered.
